atx_24pin_cable.title: 24-Pin ATX Main Motherboard Cable
atx_24pin_cable.description: Primary high-current power harness featuring 24 individually sleeved conductors delivering +12V, +5V, +3.3V, and standby rails.

eps_8pin_cable.title: 8-Pin (4+4) EPS CPU Power Cable
eps_8pin_cable.description: Dedicated +12V processor power delivery cable with separable 4+4 pin housing for multi-generation motherboard compatibility.

pcie_12vhpwr_cable.title: 16-Pin 12V-2x6 (12VHPWR) GPU Cable
pcie_12vhpwr_cable.description: PCIe Gen 5 high-power harness combining 12 heavy 16 AWG power conductors with 4 micro-gauge sideband sense lines delivering up to 600W.

pcie_8pin_cable.title: 8-Pin (6+2) Auxiliary PCIe Cable
pcie_8pin_cable.description: High-current auxiliary graphics power harness with a split 6+2 pin connector terminal supporting legacy and modern PCIe cards.

sata_power_cable.title: 15-Pin SATA Multi-Drop Power Cable
sata_power_cable.description: Flexible flat ribbon cable featuring 90-degree pass-through connectors powering solid-state drives, HDDs, and RGB controllers.

sata_data_cable.title: 7-Pin SATA 6 Gb/s Data Cable
sata_data_cable.description: Shielded differential serial ATA data cable equipped with spring-steel locking latches ensuring vibration-proof connection.

front_panel_harness.title: Front Panel I/O Wire Loom
front_panel_harness.description: Modular breakout harness routing chassis power button, reset switch, activity LEDs, and audio front-panel signals.

cable_combs.title: Acrylic Cable Management Combs
cable_combs.description: Precision laser-cut transparent organizing combs maintaining parallel wire alignment and tight custom loop aesthetics.
